signature: SUBROUTINE ZTPCON( NORM, UPLO, DIAG, N, AP, RCOND, WORK, RWORK,

params.name: norm
params.reference:
Specifies whether the 1-norm condition number or the infinity-norm condition number is required: = '1' or 'O': 1-norm;

-   `= 'I'`: Infinity-norm.

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: A is upper triangular;
-   `= 'L'`: A is lower triangular.

params.name: diag
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: A is non-unit triangular;
-   `= 'U'`: A is unit triangular.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: AP
params.reference: The upper or lower triangular matrix A, packed columnwise in a linear array. The j-th column of A is stored in the array `AP` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*j/2) = A(i,j)` for $1 \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*(2n-j)/2) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le n$. If `DIAG = 'U'`, the diagonal elements of A are not referenced and are assumed to be 1.

params.name: rcond
params.reference: The reciprocal of the condition number of the matrix A, computed as $\mathrm{RCOND} = 1/(\operatorname{norm}(A) \, \operatorname{norm}(\operatorname{inv}(A)))$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
